changeLog.change: Registered edge-to-edge request. Platform preference requested asynchronously; both assumed after independent layout audit. No new mobile binary authorised.

User explicitly selected native mobile app only. Removed the provisional web assumption before any web/application edit; stable EDGE IDs retained and requirement02 refined to native customer/business width. All 6 requirements stay in the denominator; no web change or deployment.

Implemented native-only shared full-window canvas, uncapped role/auth content and full-window modal presentation. Bounded source/renderer and iOS preview evidence recorded. Two device/role-visual gates remain PARTIAL; no exclusions or changes to prior production decisions.

User requested remaining native role-by-role phone/tablet visual acceptance, exception checks and fixes without creating new mobile binaries. Existing EDGE IDs and six-requirement denominator retained; new preview evidence distinguishes simulator/runtime installation from application builds and physical device certification.

Visual continuation: 5/14 cases pass, 1 partial, 8 untested. Repaired standalone Manager dispatch access feedback and 3 navigation glyphs. 72 tests pass with 1 existing concurrency skip; native types pass. User priority requested after repeated Device Hub selection changes and explicit CUA user-changed rejection; remaining device work and cleanup retained. No new EasyGas binary/export/install or web rollout; cached Expo Go installed on 2 dedicated simulators.

User authorized EasyGas Device Hub priority and pause of competing preview. Completed all 14/14 representative role/device simulator cases and post-fix Manager checks, actual phone/tablet software keyboards, form cancel/confirm, light/dark and tablet landscape. Repaired confirmation hidden behind full-screen form via shared top-screen dialog host. 75 tests pass, 0 fail, 1 existing concurrency skip; native types pass. QA logout/preferences cleanup and own Metro stop complete. EDGE-04/05 retain broader physical/release outstanding work: no requirement dropped or production gate changed; no new EasyGas binary/export/install/web deployment.

CI follow-up: original native job passes type/dependency/audit checks and skips mobile export. Fresh source-only checkout exposed ignored generated Android gradle.properties dependency in EDGE test. Replaced with committed/evaluated Expo configuration assertions; 16 clean-checkout edge tests pass without prebuild/build/export. Hosted web and repaired-source rerun remain pending; no broader gate closed.
